title: BCharity Social DAO
tagline: BCharity Social DAO is a blockchain community-driven social graph DAO
description: BCharity Social DAO is a blockchain community-driven social graph DAO for the public good industry that innovates a new blockchain-based tokenomics ecosystem for charitable organizations to be more cost-efficient, transparent, and accountable in their daily operations. It's decentralized to post, follow, comment, and mirror community members' publications with the DAO.
how_its_made: This project is build with SkillWallet, Lens, and IPFS protocols behind the scene of the public good social graph growing at large. With SkillWallet Protocol, it's easy to create a DAO and task management on community members. With Lens Protocol, it's decentralized to post, follow, comment, and mirror community members' publications of creating fundraising campaigns, volunteers opportunities, and charitable programs for the public good transparently. With IPFS, it's a must place to host our metadata files decentralized.
